content: A remedy refers to a medicine, application, or treatment that alleviates or cures a disease. A cure is defined as a method, device, or medication that restores good health, or the act of healing or the state of being healed. It involves the restoration of health following a disease or the return to soundness after an injury. Medicine is a substance specifically designed to promote healing, which is ingested or consumed in some manner. It can also refer to a treatment or cure, as well as the scientific study of the causes, diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of diseases or illnesses. A nutraceutical is a nutrient or food that is believed to possess curative properties or is used as a drug. It is also referred to as a 'bioceutical' and serves as a pharmaceutical alternative that claims to provide physiological benefits. In the United States, nutraceuticals are largely unregulated and fall under the same category as dietary supplements and food additives, as defined by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) under the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act.
